The high structural overlap strongly suggests the two properties share the same HSB-component extraction logic and differ only in the final platform type constructed. Collapsing them via a `PlatformColor` typealias or a shared private helper would reduce maintenance surface and ensure both properties stay in sync when the conversion logic changes.
